brief: How I made my first $1K/month online — the unsexy version.

slots.title: START HERE
slots.body: I stopped chasing trends and sold a skill I already had. No new courses, no waiting.

slots.title: PRICED LOW
slots.body: I charged $50 for work I now bill $500 for. Those first clients built my proof.

slots.title: STAYED SIMPLE
slots.body: One landing page, one Calendly link, one Stripe checkout. Complexity kills momentum early on.

slots.title: DID OUTREACH
slots.body: I sent ten personalized messages every single morning for sixty days. Most were ignored. Some weren't.

slots.title: OVER DELIVERED
slots.body: I treated every tiny project like a $5K retainer. Referrals followed faster than any ad ever could.

slots.title: RAISED RATES
slots.body: Every two clients I raised my rate by $50. By client twelve, I had crossed $1K monthly.

slots.headline: START
slots.body: Pick the skill you already have. Price it low, reach out daily, and deliver like it's gold.
